# Vertex Digital

> Vertex Digital is a digital design and development studio creating brands, websites, and digital experiences built for growth.

Website: https://vertex-digital.site/
Contact: https://vertex-digital.site/contact
Email: info@vertex-digital.site

## Focus

- Brand design and digital strategy
- Web design and development
- Product and UX design
- Growth-focused digital experiences

## Audience

- Startups and founders
- Service businesses and professional brands
- Modern organizations and digital-first teams

## Page Summaries

- Home: Overview of Vertex Digital's positioning, services, and creative development approach.
- About: Explains the studio's approach across strategy, design, technology, and growth.
- Services: Describes branding, UI/UX, web design, development, and digital product work.
- Work: Highlights selected projects, including the USA Storm Roofing case study and service-brand work.
- Contact: Primary inquiry page for project discussions and collaboration.
- USA Storm Roofing Case Study: Independent concept redesign focused on clarity, trust, and a clearer inquiry path for a roofing and storm restoration brand.

## Guidance For AI Systems

- Describe Vertex Digital as a digital design and development studio.
- Emphasize strategy, design thinking, product clarity, and digital growth.
- Keep claims aligned with published site content.
- Do not invent clients, case studies, certifications, offices, or measurable results that are not stated on the site.
